There is no such thing as "the top-level browsing context". And indeed, linking to the "remove" algorithm is no good.

In https://whatpr.org/html/8267/system-state.html#user-agent-automation we determined that https://w3c.github.io/webdriver/#dfn-current-browsing-context is the right entry point to start from, in general.

From there, I'm not sure why you'd want to consult the top-level browsing context, or check for removal. Maybe you could say more about the motivation for this step?
